verdict.rationale: Pipedream calls itself "low-code": pre-built triggers and actions for thousands of apps can be chained into workflows, with code only when needed, and the docs describe UI steps such as clicking Send Test Event. A commenter likens it to Zapier, but the evidence leans heavily toward code-first developer use (Node.js/Python steps, CLI, "Zapier for developers"), and no evidence explicitly describes a visual drag-and-drop multi-step editor for non-coders. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a visual workflow editor, evidence that multi-step workflows can be built entirely without code, and hands-on corroboration from non-technical/ops users.
